purpose: Find real readers and trusted editorial amplifiers, not payment services
rules: No unsolicited bulk email or DM automation
Never pay for reviews or promise a favorable review
Do not claim these services have agreed to cover our books
Use only public submission/contact channels, and review each pitch
No fabricated sales, reach, or conversion data

targets.name: Amazon Author Central
targets.evidence: Official KDP author page instructions, free to join
targets.ask: Reclamar página de autor y asociar ambas fichas; optimizar biografía y descripciones
targets.constraint: Requires author KDP account; no automated access

targets.name: Goodreads Author Program
targets.evidence: Official free author program with published book
targets.ask: Reclamar perfil, añadir obras y participar con autenticidad en comunidad de lectores
targets.constraint: Approval by Goodreads, book must exist in database; no spam

targets.name: IndieLift
targets.evidence: Service describes no paid subscription and reciprocal promotion
targets.ask: Registrar títulos y activar promoción cruzada recíproca con autores afines
targets.constraint: Requires genuine reciprocal promotions; no immediate guaranteed exposure

targets.name: La trinchera de los libros
targets.evidence: Contact page explicitly accepts collaborations and interview proposals
targets.ask: Proponer entrevista con corresponsal y libros sobre Alepo/Jartum
targets.constraint: Independent editorial decision; no guarantee of inclusion

targets.name: Travesura Realizada Podcast
targets.evidence: Page invites authors and publishers to ask for collaborations/interviews
targets.ask: Proponer entrevista sobre narrar acontecimientos reales desde la experiencia directa
targets.constraint: Editorial capacity limited; avoid promising review

targets.name: Noches de Historia
targets.evidence: Public professional contact cited in program description
targets.ask: Proponer episodio narrativo sobre civiles en Siria o evacuaciones en Sudán
targets.constraint: Podcast may choose not to cover contemporary events

targets.name: Revista de Libros
targets.evidence: Publication publishes literary criticism and lists general email
targets.ask: Presentar novedad editorial para valoración crítica independiente
targets.constraint: Not a dedicated unsolicited-book review submission; ask first

targets.name: La República de los Libros
targets.evidence: Outlet lists history, memoir and essay reviews; editorial contact public
targets.ask: Enviar ficha y ofrecer ejemplar digital de lectura para reseña libre
targets.constraint: Ask consent before sending files; no guaranteed publication

targets.name: Historias de papel
targets.evidence: Active 2026 interviews about published books including history and war
targets.ask: Solicitar vía canal oficial una entrevista literaria sobre Jartum y Alepo
targets.constraint: Contact method must be verified; do not invent an email

targets.name: HistoCast
targets.evidence: History/military podcast active and published as of 2026
targets.ask: Proponer conversación sobre la experiencia documental de conflictos contemporáneos
targets.constraint: Historical content focus; contact method not verified
